cards.title: 9.1 Nationalism in the Middle East
body: The end of WWI brought many changes in the Middle East.
The Ottoman Empire collapsed and its former Middle Eastern provinces were put under European powers.

cards.title: Nationalism between the wars
body: **Middle East:** after the Ottoman Empire collapsed, Britain (Iraq, Palestine, Transjordan) and France (Syria, Lebanon) ruled **mandates**. Turkey became a republic in **1923** und

cards.title: Exam answer plan: Gandhi’s methods
cards.problem: Describe Gandhi’s methods in the Indian national movement.

steps.text: Non-violence (satyagraha) and non-cooperation with British rule.
Boycott of British goods; making local cloth.

cards.answer: Mass protests such as the Salt March (1930) to break unfair laws peacefully.

cards.title: 9.2 Nationalism in Africa and Asia
body: Even though none of these nationalist movements were successful in freeing their countries before World War II, they nonetheless, began the journey toward independence.
In return for their participation, many of the soldiers hoped that their countries would be free after the war.
